hkTunnelsTolls.pageTitle: Hong Kong Tunnel Tolls 2026 | Check Current WHC, CHT, EHC Rates
hkTunnelsTolls.pageDescription: Instantly check current tolls for WHC, CHT, EHC and Tai Lam Tunnel. Auto-updates by time, no app needed. Supports private cars, taxis and goods vehicles.
hkTunnelsTolls.faq.whc.question: How much is the Western Harbour Crossing toll now?
hkTunnelsTolls.faq.whc.answer: Western Harbour Crossing uses time-varying tolls. Private car tolls range from $20 to $60 depending on the period. Visit this page to see the latest current toll automatically shown for the present time.
hkTunnelsTolls.faq.cht.question: How much is the Cross-Harbour Tunnel toll?
hkTunnelsTolls.faq.cht.answer: Cross-Harbour Tunnel private car tolls range from $20 to $40 depending on the period. This page automatically shows the current toll based on your device time.
hkTunnelsTolls.faq.all.question: How much are Hong Kong tunnel tolls?
hkTunnelsTolls.faq.all.answer: Hong Kong toll tunnels, including Western Harbour Crossing, Cross-Harbour Tunnel, Eastern Harbour Crossing and Tai Lam Tunnel, use time-varying tolls. This page instantly shows current tunnel tolls and supports private cars, taxis, motorcycles and goods vehicles.
hkTunnelsTolls.insiderPageTitle: Hong Kong Real-Time Tunnel Tolls (Beta) | JaylyDev
hkTunnelsTolls.insiderPageDescription: Provides real-time toll information for Hong Kong's three cross-harbour tunnels (Western Harbour Tunnel, Eastern Harbour Crossing, Cross-Harbour Tunnel) and Tai Lam Tunnel. Beta version app, may have errors or instability.
